description: Provider-agnostic reconciliation operation: given tenant, provider_message_id and an on-wire Message-ID, set email_sending_logs.rfc_message_id, keep the generated id in metadata.generatedRfcMessageId, be idempotent, and never silently replace one on-wire id with another.

Reconciliation rewrites every persisted copy of the generated id that feeds later thread headers (comment_threads.email_references, comment reply-context email_message_id, ticket email_metadata.references, and any others found by tracing), so later In-Reply-To/References name on-wire ids.

ResendEmailProvider returns the on-wire Message-ID as rfcMessageId after a successful send (send response if present, otherwise GET /emails/:id); a missing id or a failed fetch never fails or retries the send.

Resend webhook handling reads message_id on email.* events, including email.sent, and calls the reconciliation operation scoped to the signed tenant tag and email_id; existing workflow event publishing is unchanged.
resolveReplyTargetFromOutboundMessageId matches with rfcMessageIdLookupForms and resolves a reply naming either the on-wire id or the generated id.
Re-runnable, tenant-scoped, rate-limit-aware backfill that sets on-wire ids for existing provider_type=resend rows through the reconciliation operation.
SMTP SES on-wire id handling keeps working and shares the reconciliation contract (no third variant of on-wire id recording).
